name: Game Genie Video Game Enhancer
summary: The Game Genie was the first of what became known as ‘cheat cartridges’, interfaces which allowed games to be ‘enhanced’, usually in the form of infinite lives, invincibility, unlimited ammunition etc., by inputting codes found in its manual. It debuted in 1990, near the end of the NES
